# OpenSea registry test fixture

Unmodified MIT source extracted from the verified Ethereum contract at https://etherscan.io/address/0xA000027A9B2802E1ddf7000061001e5c005A0000#code on 2026-09-08. The test build uses the repository's OpenZeppelin 5.5.0 helpers; it is a source-level registry integration test, not a production bytecode fork or a live OpenSea order. The original Tstorish source is included.
